label: Plastic Dreams — one riff, circling
palette:
# Plastic Dreams — ESSENCE PORTRAIT (one circling riff, restraint)
# C minor, DEEP organ (low register). kick four-on-floor. NOTHING busy.
# 'organ' is aliased to 'lead' (studio engine has no organ voice — see
# meta.originalInstruments). 'gong' track is preserved but silent until a
# gong voice is added; arrangement cues on it are no-ops.
kick: x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ /1
# the spine: a deep riff that circles back every 4 bars. the ONLY melodic element.
lead: c3 ~ g3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 ~ c3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 ~ bb3 ~ c3 ~ g3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 ~ c3 ~ bb2 ~ g2 ~ ~ ~ c3 ~ g3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 ~ c3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 ~ bb3 ~ ab2 ~ eb3 ~ c3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 ~ f3 ~ eb3 ~ d3 ~ /1
# rare punctuation — a single gong boom (silent until 'gong' voice exists).
gong: x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ /1
# the LATE, only addition: one sparse offbeat hat. brought in near the end, never busy.
chh: ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ /1
arrangement:
@length 64

0   section call            ; the gong + riff + kick land like a call to the floor
0   in gong
0   in kick
0   in lead
# then: NOTHING is added for a long time. the riff just circles. this emptiness IS the hook.

16  section evolve-1        ; the riff mutates — two ghost tones appear. no new tracks.
16  set lead c3 ~ g3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 bb3 c3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 ~ bb3 ~ c3 ~ g3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 f3 c3 ~ bb2 ~ g2 ~ ~ ~ c3 ~ g3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 ~ c3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 ~ bb3 ~ ab2 ~ eb3 ~ c3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 ~ f3 ~ eb3 ~ d3 ~ /1

32  section evolve-2        ; riff reaches up an octave occasionally. gong returns once.
32  in gong
32  set lead c3 ~ g3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 bb3 c3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 c4 bb3 ~ c3 ~ g3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 f3 c3 ~ bb2 ~ g2 bb3 ~ ~ c3 ~ g3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 ~ c3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 c4 bb3 ~ ab2 ~ eb3 ~ c3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 ~ f3 ~ eb3 ~ d3 ~ /1

48  section evolve-3        ; busier INNER motion (same shape) + the single sparse hat, soft.
48  set lead c3 eb3 g3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 bb3 c3 bb3 eb3 ~ g3 c4 bb3 ~ c3 ~ g3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 f3 c3 ~ bb2 ~ g2 bb3 ~ ~ c3 bb3 g3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 ~ c3 d3 eb3 ~ g3 c4 bb3 ~ ab2 ~ eb3 ~ c3 ~ eb3 ~ g3 ~ f3 ~ eb3 ~ d3 ~ /1
48  in chh
48  gain chh 0.5 4
# loop: the cycle continues. there is no drop and no breakdown — the trance is the point.
# NET: across 64 bars the riff slowly densifies WITHOUT the arrangement ever becoming busy.

meta.title: Plastic Dreams (essence portrait)
meta.essence: ONE deep organ riff that circles and slowly evolves over a steady four-on-the-floor pulse. Hypnotic BECAUSE almost nothing else happens. The build is the riff MUTATING, never layers piling up. A rare gong punctuates.
meta.inspiration: Jaydee — 'Plastic Dreams' (1992). COPYRIGHTED work; this is an inspired-by homage using the generic four-on-floor idiom + an ORIGINAL circling riff evoking the deep-organ character, NOT a transcription.
meta.designPrinciple: ESSENCE-FIRST, NOT TEMPLATE. RESTRAINT IS THE RULE. Only kick + the single organ riff + a rare gong. NO chord stabs, NO arp, NO busy hats, NO section-swap drama. The earlier version added all of those and destroyed the hypnotism. Evolution happens INSIDE the riff via slow mutation, not by adding tracks.

originalInstruments.organ: Renamed to 'lead' in this preset because the studio's voice engine has no organ. The intended timbre is a deep Hammond/drawbar character (stacked sines, percussive attack, slight chorus/vibrato) — a synth-voice task, not a pattern task.
originalInstruments.gong: Track preserved with original name; currently silent because the engine has no gong voice. Arrangement 'in gong' cues are no-ops until a voice is added.

essenceNotes.whatChangedVsFailedVersion: Earlier version added hats, claps, chord stabs, an arp, and dramatic section swaps — every one of which fights 'skeletal and hypnotic'. Now: kick + riff only, and change happens by mutating the riff, not by stacking layers.
essenceNotes.whyMutationNotLayering: Hypnosis comes from sameness; interest comes from slow change to the SAME element. So the riff evolves in place (3 mutation frames) while the texture stays nearly empty.
essenceNotes.theGong: Punctuation, not groove. Rare hits mark sections like the original's opening gong-call.
essenceNotes.cymaticsCoupling: A near-static spectrum dominated by one low-mid riff = a steady, slowly-breathing field that shifts subtly as the riff mutates. The visual hypnotism mirrors the musical hypnotism — exactly because nothing busy is competing.

caveats.copyright: Original is copyrighted; this reproduces only the generic four-on-floor idiom + an ORIGINAL riff evoking the character. Homage, not cover.
caveats.swing: House sits slightly behind the grid; the straight 16th grid can't swing (engine feature). Straight here — logged.
caveats.restraintIsFragile: Resist the urge to 'improve' this by adding parts. If it starts sounding busy, the essence is lost. Any addition must be tiny and late.
